title: Isolate language-specific build runners and add artifact signing to reduce CI flakiness
creator: Maya R. Chen
description: Problem: Flaky CI runs and long rebuild times are disproportionately coming from a small set of language toolchains (Go, Rust, Python wheels) that share a single monolithic builder image and cache. This ticket scopes a two-part approach: 1) split the monorepo CI into isolated, hermetic language runners (lightweight images per language + pinned toolchain bundles) so language-specific updates/flake do not impact others; 2) introduce artifact signing for prebuilt caches and toolchain bundles so cache promotion across environments is auditable and resistant to accidental cache poisoning.
comments: 2025-01-10 - Maya R. Chen: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded to docs: https://docs.redwood.com/eng/ci/isolate-runners. Agreed scope: split Go/Rust/Python under separate worker pools, retain shared js/infra images. Risk: initial spike in total storage for prebuilt artifacts.

2025-01-20 - Owen Patel: POC complete for separate Go runner. Built minimal go-builder: golang 1.21 + pinned modules cache. Wall-clock: parallel Go builds reduced median runtime from 9m->3.2m on CI-agents. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci-config/pull/1123

2025-01-29 - Security (Priya Singh): Reviewed artifact signing design. Suggested HSM-backed signing for release promotion; for initial rollout allow CI-signed blobs with rotating keys and audit logs. Created security checklist in Confluence.

2025-02-05 - Owen Patel: Implemented signing metadata (signed_manifest.json) and verifier in the runner bootstrap. Verified cross-region promotion flow from staging to prod. Integration tests added: ci/integration/signed-cache-verify.sh

2025-02-12 - Maya R. Chen: Observability changes merged: separate build metrics (queue time, runtime, cache hit) emitted with runner.label. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/d/ci-builds/language-runners (shareable internally). Early signal: Python runner queue time down 45%.

2025-02-18 - Owen Patel: Blocker found - some prebuilt Rust artifacts contain non-deterministic metadata leading to signing failures. Next steps: add reproducible-build wrapper (strip timestamps) and re-run promotion. Estimated follow-up: 2 pts. See GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/build-tools/issues/78
